Features.title: Civic Lense
Features.subtitle: An app that makes reporting civic issues simple and effective through automated geo-tagging, routing, and community forums.
Features.overview: Simplify the process of reporting civic problems to local governments...
goalsAndObjectives: Reduce friction in community-to-government reporting channels.
Foster localized civic engagement through state and city forums.
Gamify community responsibility using transparent regional leaderboards.

Features.title: Hangout Drive
Features.subtitle: An intelligent cloud media vault that automatically organizes social gatherings by people, locations, and moods.
Features.overview: A dedicated storage solution designed specifically for social groups...
goalsAndObjectives: Eliminate the hassle of manual media sorting after group events.
Provide intuitive, contextual memory retrieval using AI analysis.
Create a seamless collaborative space for friends to centralize shared media.

Features.title: Ishaara
Features.subtitle: A Duolingo-style Indian Sign Language (ISL) learning platform with real-time hand tracking and computer vision translation.
Features.overview: Ishaara bridges the communication gap between the deaf community and their families...
goalsAndObjectives: Lower the barriers to ISL literacy for families and communities through accessible, 10-minute daily lessons.
Deliver low-latency, on-device one-hand sign verification using MediaPipe tracking and TensorFlow Lite classifiers.
Eradicate social isolation for deaf individuals at home and in public spaces via seamless live gesture-to-speech translation.
Establish a clear product roadmap extending into assistive hardware companions and robotic sign-demonstration models.

Features.title: NeuroLearn
Features.subtitle: An AI-powered 3D and VR educational platform designed for neurodiverse students and infrastructure-deprived school systems.
Features.overview: NeuroLearn is an immersive educational ecosystem deployed across a 3D web portal...
goalsAndObjectives: Bridge the infrastructural gap in rural and government schools by deploying cost-flexible, virtual learning environments.
Enhance engagement and focus for neurodiverse students through highly tactile, spatial, and gamified lesson delivery.
Build a robust content pipeline leveraging open NCERT curriculums optimized for conversational AI models.
Ensure full DPDP Act compliance and WCAG-aligned accessibility standards to securely protect and serve student users.
